units.title: Basic Survival Kit
units.description: Greetings, basic expressions, and essential interactions.

lessons.title: Greetings & Welcomes
lessons.description: Learn to say Hello, Goodbye, and check how someone is doing.

flashcards.context: Hola, ¿cómo estás? (Hello, how are you?)
Buenos días, mi amigo. (Good morning, my friend.)
Adiós, nos vemos mañana. (Goodbye, see you tomorrow.)

lessons.title: Essential Needs
lessons.description: Learn to ask for water, food, and locate the bathroom.

flashcards.context: Disculpe, ¿dónde está el baño? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)
Tengo sed. Agua, por favor. (I am thirsty. Water, please.)

units.title: Social & Eating Out
units.description: Cafe interactions, introductions, and ordering foods.

lessons.title: At the Café
lessons.description: Order coffee, pastries, and request the check.

flashcards.context: Un café, por favor, con leche. (A coffee, please, with milk.)
Camarero, la cuenta, por favor. (Waiter, the check, please.)

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.description: State your name, age, and where you are from.

flashcards.context: Hola, me llamo Carlos. (Hello, my name is Carlos.)
Mucho gusto, encantado de conocerle. (Nice to meet you, pleased to meet you.)

units.title: Navigation & Travel
units.description: Asking directions, taking transit, and navigating the city.

lessons.title: Directions
lessons.description: Understand straight, left, right, and locate key sites.

flashcards.context: ¿Dónde está la estación de tren? (Where is the train station?)
Camina todo recto, y luego a la izquierda. (Walk straight ahead, then to the left.)

units.title: Arrival & Welcome
units.description: Navigate airport interactions and basic politeness.

lessons.title: Airport Greetings
lessons.description: Learn to state your destination and respond politely.

flashcards.context: Welcome to New York! Pleased to meet you.
Excuse me, where is passport control?

lessons.title: Basic Politeness
lessons.description: Use Thank you, Please, and Excuse me.

flashcards.context: Thank you very much for your help!
Excuse me, please, I need to pass.

units.title: Everyday Social
units.description: Restaurant orders, personal details, and small talk.

lessons.title: Restaurant Order
lessons.description: Order meals and pay the check.

flashcards.context: Excuse me, I would like to order dinner.
We are done eating. The check, please.

lessons.title: Personal Details
lessons.description: Tell others your name and origin country.

flashcards.context: Hello, my name is John.
Nice to meet you. Where are you from?

units.title: Exploring the City
units.description: Locate sights, ask directions, and call a taxi.

lessons.title: Getting Around
lessons.description: Ask how to get to key city landmarks.

flashcards.context: How do I get to the central station?
Go straight, turn left, then right.

units.title: First Contact
units.description: Polite greetings and introductions in French.

lessons.title: Basic Expressions
lessons.description: Learn Bonjour, Merci, and basic politeness.

flashcards.context: Bonjour, comment ça va ? (Hello, how is it going?)
Un café, s'il vous plaît. (A coffee, please.)
Merci beaucoup pour l'aide. (Thank you very much for the help.)

lessons.title: Emergency Needs
lessons.description: Locate restrooms and request basic hydration.

flashcards.context: Excusez-moi, où sont les toilettes ? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)
Un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît. (A glass of water, please.)

units.title: Café Culture
units.description: Interact at bistros, order food, and meet locals.

lessons.title: Ordering Drinks
lessons.description: Order classic croissants, coffees, and ask for the bill.

flashcards.context: Un croissant et un café, s'il vous plaît. (A croissant and coffee, please.)
Garçon, l'addition, s'il vous plaît. (Waiter, the check, please.)

lessons.title: Introductions
lessons.description: State your name and tell others you are pleased to meet them.

flashcards.context: Je m'appelle Marie, et vous ? (My name is Marie, and you?)
Enchanté de faire votre connaissance. (Pleased to meet you.)

units.title: City Directions
units.description: Ask for landmarks and navigate the Parisian metro.

lessons.title: Getting Around
lessons.description: Locate metro stations and ask if landmarks are nearby.

flashcards.context: Où est la station de métro la plus proche ? (Where is the nearest metro station?)
Allez tout droit, puis tournez à gauche. (Go straight ahead, then turn left.)

units.title: Essential Expressions
units.description: Greeting people and basic survival essentials in Mandarin.

flashcards.context: 你好，我的朋友。 (Hello, my friend.)
谢谢你的帮助。 (Thank you for your help.)
再见，明天见。 (Goodbye, see you tomorrow.)

lessons.title: Essential Survival
lessons.description: Learn to locate the restroom and ask for water.

flashcards.context: 请问，厕所在哪里？ (Excuse me, where is the restroom?)
我要一杯水，谢谢。 (I want a glass of water, thank you.)

units.title: Social Dining
units.description: Order food, introduce yourself, and handle bistro bills.

lessons.title: In the Restaurant
lessons.description: Order dinner and ask the waiter to bring the check.

flashcards.context: 服务员，我想点菜。 (Waiter, I would like to order.)
吃饱了，买单，谢谢。 (Finished eating, the bill please, thank you.)

lessons.description: State your name and declare pleasure in meeting others.

flashcards.context: 你好，我叫王明。 (Hello, my name is Wang Ming.)

flashcards.front: 很高兴认识你 (Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ)
flashcards.context: 很高兴认识你，李华。 (Nice to meet you, Li Hua.)

units.title: Navigation & Directions
units.description: Locate metro stations and ask for walking directions.

lessons.title: Finding Places
lessons.description: Locate the nearest subway and understand basic paths.

flashcards.front: 地铁站在哪里？ (Dìtiězhàn zài nǎlǐ?)
flashcards.context: 请问，地铁站在哪里？ (Excuse me, where is the subway station?)

flashcards.front: 直走，左转 (Zhí zǒu, zuǒ zhuǎn)
flashcards.context: 一直往前走，然后向左转。 (Go straight ahead, then turn left.)

units.title: Welcome & Common Words

मदद के लिए धन्यवाद। (Thank you for the help.)
अलविदा, कल मिलेंगे। (Goodbye, we will meet tomorrow.)

lessons.title: Survival Essentials

units.title: Social Interactions

flashcards.context: नमस्ते, आपसे मिलकर खुशी हुई। (Hello, nice to meet you.)

flashcards.context: एक कप गरम चाय, कृपया। (A cup of hot tea, please.)

units.title: In the City
units.description: Locate transit hubs and ask walking directions.

lessons.title: Directions
lessons.description: Ask for stations and understand straight or turns.

flashcards.context: रेलवे स्टेशन कहाँ है? (Where is the railway station?)

flashcards.front: सीधे जाइए, फिर बाएँ (Seedhe jaiye, phir baaye)
flashcards.context: यहाँ से सीधे जाइए, फिर बाएँ मुड़िए। (Go straight from here, then turn left.)

flashcards.context: Здравствуйте, меня зовут Иван. (Hello, my name is Ivan.)
Очень рад встрече с вами. (Very glad to meet you.)
